mapper.select: WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision) * FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery WHERE succeeded = TRUE ORDER BY platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, discovered_at DESC, id DESC ) SELECT connection.id::TEXT AS connection_id, connection.version AS connection_revision, connection.display_name AS connection_display_name, connection.region AS residency, connection.capability_intent AS declared_capability, candidate.model_code, candidate.display_name, COALESCE(confirmation.model_type, candidate.model_type) AS model_type, COALESCE(array_to_string(confirmation.capabilities, ','), array_to_string(candidate.capabilities, ',')) AS capabilities, CASE WHEN confirmation.discovery_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED_BY_ADMIN' ELSE candidate.classification END AS classification FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication ON publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version JOIN latest ON latest.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND latest.platform_provider_connection_revision = connection.version JOIN model_runtime.platform_discovered_model candidate ON candidate.discovery_id = latest.id LEFT JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_candidate_confirmation confirmation ON confirmation.discovery_id = candidate.discovery_id AND confirmation.model_code = candidate.model_code WHERE connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND latest.expires_at > #{now} AND connection.last_probed_at <= #{now} AND connection.last_probed_at > CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND (connection.discovery_profile <> 'SILICONFLOW_RERANK_MODELS_API' OR (candidate.source_profile = 'SILICONFLOW_RERANK_MODELS_API' AND candidate.mapping_version = #{sourceMappingVersion} AND candidate.mapping_digest = #{sourceMappingDigest})) ORDER BY connection.display_name, candidate.model_code, candidate.candidate_key
mapper.sql: WITH current_discovery AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (discovery.platform_provider_connection_id, discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision) discovery.id, discovery.expires_at, discovery.discovered_at, connection.discovery_profile FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery discovery JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection ON connection.id = discovery.platform_provider_connection_id WHERE connection.id = #{connectionId} AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.version = #{revision} AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision = #{revision} AND discovery.succeeded = TRUE ORDER BY discovery.platform_provider_connection_id, discovery.platform_provider_connection_revision, discovery.discovered_at DESC, discovery.id DESC ), candidate_projection AS ( SELECT candidate.discovery_id, candidate.model_code, candidate.display_name, candidate.candidate_key, candidate.source_profile, candidate.list_source, candidate.mapping_version, candidate.mapping_digest, COALESCE(confirmation.model_type, candidate.model_type) AS model_type, CASE WHEN confirmation.discovery_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED_BY_ADMIN' ELSE candidate.classification END AS classification, COALESCE(array_to_string(confirmation.capabilities, ','), array_to_string(candidate.capabilities, ',')) AS capabilities FROM model_runtime.platform_discovered_model candidate JOIN current_discovery ON current_discovery.id = candidate.discovery_id AND current_discovery.expires_at > #{now} AND current_discovery.discovered_at <= #{now} AND (current_discovery.discovery_profile <> 'SILICONFLOW_RERANK_MODELS_API' OR (candidate.source_profile = 'SILICONFLOW_RERANK_MODELS_API' AND candidate.mapping_version = #{sourceMappingVersion} AND candidate.mapping_digest = #{sourceMappingDigest})) LEFT JOIN model_runtime.platform_model_candidate_confirmation confirmation ON confirmation.discovery_id = candidate.discovery_id AND confirmation.model_code = candidate.model_code )

FROM candidate_projection WHERE concat_ws(' ', model_code, display_name, CASE WHEN classification = 'REQUIRES_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION' THEN '待管理员确认' WHEN model_type = 'CHAT' THEN '对话模型' WHEN model_type = 'EMBEDDING' THEN '向量模型' WHEN model_type = 'RERANK' THEN '重排序模型' ELSE '待确认' END) ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\'
mapper.select: SELECT model_code, model_type, capabilities, classification, display_name, discovery_id, source_profile, list_source, mapping_version, mapping_digest ORDER BY model_code ASC, candidate_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_provider_model_discovery (id, platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, succeeded, result_code, elapsed_millis, discovered_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{connectionId}, #{revision}, #{succeeded}, #{resultCode}, #{elapsedMillis}, #{discoveredAt}, #{expiresAt})

INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_discovered_model (discovery_id, model_code, model_type, capabilities, classification, display_name, source_profile, list_source, mapping_version, mapping_digest) VALUES (#{discoveryId}, #{modelCode}, #{modelType}, string_to_array(#{capabilities}, ','), #{classification}, #{displayName}, #{sourceProfile}, #{listSource}, #{mappingVersion}, #{mappingDigest})
mapper.select: SELECT model_code, model_type, capabilities, classification, display_name, discovery_id, source_profile, list_source, mapping_version, mapping_digest FROM candidate_projection WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} AND (model_type = #{modelType} OR (classification = 'REQUIRES_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_projection exact WHERE exact.model_code = candidate_projection.model_code AND exact.model_type = #{modelType})))
